claim: Three independent codes agree at steady state
evidence_value: FV within 0.4522 K and Icepak within 0.0859 K of the MOOSE FE reference
explicitly_not_claimed: NOT experimental validation — no hardware was measured

claim: The agreement is backed by four independent conditions
evidence_value: exact mathematics, discrete integrity, matched observable, independent codes
explicitly_not_claimed: Not a statement about physical fidelity

claim: Faster on matched repeated transient stepping
evidence_value: 76.8 s vs 1046.4 s at 400 steps = 13.62x, one core
explicitly_not_claimed: NOT a general speed claim; scope is matched repeated stepping only

claim: The same code is SLOWER for one steady solve
explicitly_not_claimed: Stated deliberately; must not be omitted when quoting T3

claim: A greedy gating policy exceeds the thermal limit used here
evidence_value: 98.93 C oracle / 101.37 C Ansys vs 95 C
explicitly_not_claimed: EPEPS 2026 published application result; produced before the post-publication solver correction and not rerun.
Absolute temperatures could shift under the later solver correction

claim: The two architectures were frozen before being solved
evidence_value: one ETM replay each, no sweep, no tuning
explicitly_not_claimed: Not an optimiser result and not a search over architectures

claim: Which rail crosses the substrate is set by where conversion sits
evidence_value: Z1 23.43 A at 48 V through 74 um; Z2 1000 A at 1 V through 300 um
explicitly_not_claimed: 'The TSV carries 48 V' and 'the TSV carries 1 V' are both wrong as general claims

claim: Vertical loss follows the assigned rail, not the via geometry
evidence_value: Z2 0.9905 W; Z1 below 0.2 mW through a 4.1x SHORTER path
explicitly_not_claimed: Z1's ledger value is slightly negative (small-signal artefact); reported as a bound

claim: Moving the regulator costs about 2 W of about 137 W
evidence_value: 137.292 -> 139.659 W; TSV is ~42 % of the change, the rest is thermal feedback
explicitly_not_claimed: The thermal-feedback share is a coupled-model result, not an independent measurement

claim: Buildability is set by conductor-plane topology, not layer count
evidence_value: a tier permutation takes worst via AR 5.050 -> 0.833 at constant parts, area and 1921 um stack height
explicitly_not_claimed: NOT manufacturing qualification: microvia current allowable, capture-pad diameter and a vendor design rule remain OPEN

claim: Warpage, driver and response are three different quantities
explicitly_not_claimed: A response is NOT damage, damage is NOT life, life is NOT failure

claim: The hotter architecture has the lower local response
evidence_value: Z2 is +8.14 K hotter with 16.30 % less driver and 18.43 % less response
explicitly_not_claimed: No life claim. Magnitude conditional on a constitutive card used far outside its fitted stress window

claim: The displacement change dominates; the hotter joint offsets part of it
explicitly_not_claimed: The two effects do not superpose exactly; the creep response is nonlinear

claim: The result is insensitive to further tolerance relaxation
evidence_value: CETOL 5e-2 and 1e-1 are bit-identical: 336 increments, 0 cutbacks, D_eps = 1.226006
explicitly_not_claimed: No tighter tolerance converges. Once CETOL is loose enough to start, the step schedule binds. Agreement with a tight-tolerance reference is NOT demonstrated

claim: Observations about method, not product recommendations
evidence_value: five method observations drawn from the two studies
explicitly_not_claimed: No claim about what SK hynix uses or should use; no architecture is recommended

claim: Consolidated limitations are stated on a slide, not buried
evidence_value: 8 limitations across transient, realizability, mechanics, thermal/EM and scope
explicitly_not_claimed: Includes: a full-wave HFSS attempt did not converge; no conjugate CFD
